test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

You are asked to tell the plumber to mend all the pipes.

options.text: Command the plumber mending all the pipes.
Tell the plumber to mend all the pipes.
All the pipes must be mend.
Tell the plumber mending all the pipes.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Tell the plumber to mend all the pipes."**
